description: Evaluate ability to design safe state-publishing contracts to avoid dual-writes.
prompt: Design a billing service flow that updates the database and publishes a message to a queue. Explain why publishing directly inside a SQL transaction is unsafe and show the outbox pattern schema.

description: Evaluate ability to handle duplicate message deliveries in distributed environments.
prompt: Explain what happens when a message broker delivers a message twice (at-least-once delivery guarantee). Show how you would implement an idempotent message consumer using an idempotency key.
